title: Sommertime
tagline: A simple booking system for a one-person hair salon
description:
Sommertime is a small booking app for a hairdresser who works a few days a month and has a handful of regular customers. Customers create a profile with their email, pick a treatment, a day and a time, and can move or cancel the appointment themselves. There are no payments.

The hairdresser has an admin area for opening days for booking, seeing bookings in a month or week calendar, booking on behalf of customers, keeping notes on each customer and editing the list of treatments and prices. If the hairdresser falls ill, a whole day can be cancelled; every customer that day gets an email with a suggested new time and a link that goes straight to booking it.

Customers get a welcome email, a confirmation with a calendar file attached and a reminder the day before. Everything is built for phones first and runs on free tiers.

This public version runs as a demo when no database is set up: it fills an in-memory database with made-up customers and bookings, and a bar at the top lets you switch between the customer and the hairdresser view.
